JB Financial Invests $27.2 Million in Upstage, Expands AI Cooperation

JB Financial Group has invested $27.2 million (₩40 billion) in South Korean AI technology company Upstage and secured a stake of about 2%. The move is being viewed as a step that gives greater weight to technology cooperation by having a regional financial group make a direct equity investment in an AI company.

On Oct. 20, JB Financial Group said its three affiliates, Jeonbuk Bank, Kwangju Bank and JB Woori Capital, signed an investment agreement with Upstage for a Series C-2 round worth $27.2 million (₩40 billion). The three JB Financial companies led the first investment in the round, and Upstage plans to continue raising additional capital for the C-2 round.

The investment is a follow-up to the “Strategic Partnership for Financial and AI Technology and Business Cooperation” memorandum of understanding, or MOU, signed on Sept. 14. Since the MOU, the two sides have discussed cooperation projects including the joint development of AI agents for application to core financial operations, and have elevated the framework of their cooperation from a partnership to an equity investment.

JB Financial has been pursuing a group-wide AI transformation, or AX, in earnest since this year. It is working to improve productivity in areas including IT development processes, compliance and corporate lending processes, and said the latest investment has secured a long-term cooperation framework rather than a one-off technology introduction.

JB Financial and Upstage will pursue ▲joint development of financial-specialized AI agents ▲training and personnel exchanges to internalize AI capabilities among employees ▲regional AI cooperation projects linked with local governments and universities. The plan is to first apply AI to time-consuming repetitive tasks such as document processing and screening, changing the way work itself is performed.

“This investment reflects our determination to ensure that AI cooperation does not stop at a declaration but leads to substantive changes at the operational level of our affiliates,” JB Financial Group Chairman Kim Ki-hong said. “We will use AI not simply as a work-support tool but as a means to structurally innovate the way we work and our productivity, and create a tangible AX success case for a financial group.”

_**(Reference: USD equivalent, KRW/USD ≈ 1,471. Applied as ₩1,471 = $1.00 for convenience.)**_
